title: Changelogs and releases
description: Practice changelogs and releases using a checkable offline policy or disposable Git repository, a failing starter, and an independently verified repair.
objectives: Explain changelogs and releases as an engineering policy, not a magic Git behavior
Reproduce the insufficient starter policy with concrete counterexamples
Apply the rule to representative team inputs and document real hosting limitations
rubric: I reproduce the changelogs and releases policy failure.
I can explain which policy is enforced locally versus by a Git host.
I demonstrate a passing repaired implementation and one negative edge case.
